The Autonomous AI Agent Challenge
Your mission is to identify a significant business or developer problem and build an innovative solution using Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) and/or the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol. Your agent must demonstrate the power of autonomous systems by implementing either a continuous loop for ongoing tasks and parallel agents to divide and conquer complex workflows.

We are looking for creative and impactful solutions that showcase the future of AI agents. Winning demos will not only showcase a functional solution but must also clearly explain:

   • The benefits of using a loop and/or parallel    agent architecture for your specific use case.
   • How they used ADK and/or A2A protocol you    used to build your agents and why they were    critical to your design.

Judging & Demo Requirements:
We want to see not just what the teams built, but how they built it and the unique architectural / tools choices they made. Winning demos will be judged on their ability to clearly explain the following, in addition to showcasing a functional and impactful solution:

   • The "Why": What are the specific benefits of using a loop and/or parallel agent architecture for your chosen use case?
   • The "How": Which features in the ADK and/or A2A protocol did you use, and why were they critical to your agent's design and success?
